title: Chapter 866
paragraphs: Chapter 866
Episode 216. First Golden Ship (2)
[Introduce me to that friend too. Come to think of it, I don't remember having a proper conversation with your phoenix since joining the alliance. Surely, it's a magnificent immortal.]
"Understood, Ameris."
To summon Tes, they headed to the underground training ground in Tikan Palace. This training ground was where Tes was first summoned when the palace was still a mansion.
"I suddenly remember being beaten by Alisa. I was defeated 109 times, and I won the last duel by summoning Tes."
Murakan and Qucantel remembered the day they first saw Tes summoned by Jin. They were so shocked at the time that they even dropped their forks during the celebration party for Jin.
Hwaaaak-!
A summoning circle was formed with blue fire spreading all around the dueling arena. When Tes revealed himself from within, Qucantel bowed deeply.
"I greet the lord of the flame realm."
As always, Murakan kept his head stiff and teetered on one foot, only to be pecked by Tes's beak.
"Ah, how long will you torment me like this! I'm Murakan, you know, treating me like this every time is too much, ugh! It hurts! Stop swearing, really!"
[Every time I feel it... Jin, your guardian dragon often seems to lack intelligence. Perhaps it was born too strong to have the chance to think.]
"If he were Murakan, it would have been the same even if he was born weak, probably."
[Hmm, I guess so. Indeed, your first sister was a powerful one from birth and lacked a little in perceptiveness, but she's not like Murakan.]
When Ameris approached, Tes, who had been pecking Murakan eagerly, turned his head.
[Nice to meet you, Tes. At first glance, you seem to be a very old immortal. I am Ameris, who once took on the duty of guarding the boundary after the Sun God.]
Murakan naturally expected Tes to be furious. He didn't know of any god who could get away with speaking casually to Tes.
Knowing Tes's temperament, Qucantel was slightly tense as well, but Tes surprisingly nodded his head, showing a friendly reaction.
"What! Nice to meet you!? Look here Tes, this guy is much weaker than me! And he's even speaking formally? You're not that kind of guy!"
[Murakan, be quiet while the adults are talking.]
Although Tes was speaking in a spiritual language, which Jin couldn't hear, he had a rough idea of the mood of the conversation.

[Ah... I just realized that Jin can't hear these spiritual conversations. Tes, have you never had a direct conversation with Jin before? Has this idiot Murakan or Qucantel always acted as some sort of interpreter for you?]
Tes nodded once more.

[No matter how strict the law of separation is, it is inappropriate for an immortal like you to not even have a chat with the contractor. Fortunately, a few minor abilities have returned thanks to Valeria recently restoring part of my memory, so I will provide some assistance.]
Ameris started whispering in a language that was not understandable. It was like reciting a spell.
At the end of the spell, Jin was able to hear Tes's voice for the first time.
[Hmm... How clever, Ameris. A power to convert spiritual language into human sound.]
Jin was so surprised that he could only stare at Tes. Murakan and Qucantel had the same reaction.
"Tes is talking...!?"
[This is the first time we're communicating directly like this, Jin. Thanks to Ameris, it's a very rare experience.]
"It feels a bit awkward to have a conversation like this, considering we've been together since the reserve knight days."
[You have a cute voice.]
"Why can't I speak informally when even the kid does?"

[This bastard Murakan is just hopeless. Even after being hit again and again, he never learns. Is it because he is not from the flame realm? Try coming to the flame realm and see if you don't go 'Ah, I must be crazy'. If you mess around like this, you might really die, understand? What if you are Murakan? What does that make you? Jin is my precious contractor, and you're just a stranger to me.]
Whack! Tes clenched his wing like a fist and punched Murakan. Just as Murakan always said 'Stop swearing', Tes was the owner of a rather rough speech.
Although it was a little off from the image he had been expecting, Jin was pleased with the thought of being able to have conversations with Tes in the future.
[Hmm, I was slightly delayed because of this damned thing, Ameris. I apologize for my unsightly behavior.]
[I don't mind, in fact, I find it quite refreshing.]

[You must be having a lot of worries these days, Ameris. With Jito breaking the order of separation and rampaging on the surface... They should just live quietly underground, why are they always so greedy for the surface?]

[If all the immortals with the greatest power after the Sun God were like you, this wouldn't have happened. That's probably why Jin summoned you. You're from the flame realm, does your realm also exist underground?]
[No. If my realm was in the underworld, that scoundrel Jito would not have been able to make such a fuss... Ho-ho!]
All of a sudden, Tes expressed a look of surprise and delight.
[You are indeed the one who guarded the separation of the worlds. Even using an interpreter, it was impossible to accurately convey information about my realm to the human world.]
[It was the order I supervised, so this much modification is possible. When I had nine heads, I could modify much more. It's just that I didn't because it wasn't necessary and it was dangerous.]

Jin realized once again that Ameris was an especially high-ranking being among the immortals. Even Tes, who could slay mid-tier gods with a few breaths, couldn't escape the order of separation by himself.
[So, where is your realm, the flame realm?]
[It exists at the highest point in the sky.]
"So, was the place we visited before the highest point in the sky? I just thought it was another dimension or subspace."
[The end of the sky...? Ah, don't tell me. Are you the immortal who governs reincarnation?]
At that, Tes nodded with a startle.

It was information that mortals should not know. However, the only mortals in the training ground now were Jin, Murakan, and Qucantel, and since the world was in turmoil, he judged that this much would be okay.
[Yes. To be eternal, immortal, and to protect the cycle of reincarnation, that was the mission given to me after the death of the Sun God. That's why I have such great power.]
Similarly, this too was information that Tes himself could not reveal to the human world. Jin listened to the greatest secrets of the world with a reverent heart.

[I heard from Soldreth and the witch in the past that such an immortal must exist. They said that even they could not ascend any further, that there was a blocked sky, and it was full of fire. So it was you... carrying a burden as great as mine.]
Tes and Jito.
The two were beings that governed the order of reincarnation, or what is called the afterlife, and hell, respectively. All lives go to either Tes's or Jito's realm when they die.
Ameris explained this and looked at Jin.
"So, Tes and Jito are beings that stand at completely opposite ends."

[Yes, Jin. Although I said he is nothing, it assumes that I fought with him in my realm with the power of the original god. If Jito invades the earth with all his power restored, you and your colleagues will not be able to handle it.]
"So, can't Tes influence the human world more like Jito?"

[That's something we need to think about. Since Jito used a method that ignores the order, there should also be a way for me. However, it's impossible for both me and Jito to fully recover our power.]
[Even if Jito regains only a part of his old power, it will be a big problem. As you can see, I have lost many powers, Tes. If you can help our alliance, it would be of great assistance.]
[I will try my best to find a way. The first thing that comes to mind is to incarnate through Jin's body, as I did in the old Oterium... but that would result in Jin's death.]

[Dying to protect the world can be noble, but it's an ending no one among me and my colleagues wants. Furthermore, even if you incarnate through Jin, it will not work against Jito who himself came to the surface.]
[Probably not. As much as I hate to admit it, he's not much different from me in essence. And another thought comes to mind... Jin. You've met Shinu recently, haven't you?]
Jin nodded.
"I have."
[His fire and mine are polar opposites. But essentially, they're the same fire, so I wonder if I might be able to manifest using him.]
"Through Shinu's powers..."
-Tell me now what Shinu and Kellyak want from me.
-Yes, Sir Jin. They both hope that you would heal Sir Kellyak.
He remembered the conversation he had with the young fire dragon, Py, the day Shinu appeared.
At that time, Jin heard about the Church of the Sun God and their purpose from Shinu.
'Shinu gave me a lot of information even after I refused to heal Kellyak because it was necessary for him too that I stop the Church of the Sun God.'
This meant that depending on how Shinu felt about the underworld and Jito, a deal could be possible.
It was not an immediate issue. Shinu and Kellyak were still missing.
"I'll find out more about Shinu while preparing for the war with the underworld, Tes. Shinu wanted to trade with me, so we might be able to communicate."
Of course, the best outcome would not be a trade but to 'suppress' Shinu and put him in a situation where he had no choice but to follow Jin's will.
If it had been when Kellyak was the head of Zipel, it might have been different, but now it was a perfectly feasible scenario.
[So, it's not impossible for you to manifest.]

[That's right, Ameris. Ever since I started contracting with humans, not as the administrator of reincarnation but as a phoenix, the most satisfactory contractor has been Jin. I have no intention of letting him die at the hands of Jito.]
Tes looked at Jin.
[Don't worry and keep moving forward, Jin. I'll continue to protect you.]
